Although rumors of a $1,399 starting price for the iPhone 18 Pro may be exaggerated, there's no doubt this year's lineup will see significant price hikes.

Apple has already laid the groundwork for the upcoming pricing shock with its new Apple Upgrade program, and T-Mobile is now responding with a new three-year installment plan...

Back in June, Apple implemented notable price increases across most of its product lines to cope with soaring memory costs. While current iPhone models weren't included in those adjustments, it's almost certain that the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max will be priced higher than last year's equivalent models.

The Apple Upgrade lease program can reduce your monthly payments on a range of products including the iPhone. However, the biggest catch is that you don't own the product once your payment term ends. Many users may end up in an endless cycle of renewing their Apple Upgrade leases.

T-Mobile is launching a new installment plan tomorrow that lets customers spread the cost of their iPhone and all related fees over three years instead of two. Called EIP Flex 36, the plan will be offered with zero interest and zero down payment, according to the company.

It's worth noting two conditions: the zero down payment and zero interest only apply to customers with good credit. The fine print indicates that some customers could face APRs as high as 24%. However, if you qualify and plan to keep your next iPhone for three years or more, this could be an attractive option.
